subject.title: [Feature]: Support direct video upload to LLM

question: Should OpenClaw support provider-native video as a first-class chat/model input, and if so what core/plugin contract and raw-media security policy should own it?
rationale: The current source gap is clear, but the fix crosses API shape, provider routing, raw-media egress, retention/limits, model capability metadata, and fallback behavior that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Approve first-class video input
options.body: Define a coherent WebChat/Gateway/model-catalog/provider contract with security limits and land or replace an implementation that follows it.

options.title: Keep video in media understanding
options.body: Defer direct chat/model video uploads and document the existing video.description media-understanding path as the supported workflow for now.

options.title: Prove provider-specific seams first
options.body: Let provider plugins validate native video behavior behind provider-owned seams before adding a generic core chat-video content contract.

recommendation.title: Approve first-class video input
recommendation.body: Define a coherent WebChat/Gateway/model-catalog/provider contract with security limits and land or replace an implementation that follows it.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner has the strongest recent history in model-catalog/media architecture and visible routing context on the product/security boundary.
